body:
## Summary
- Adds `medas-api/guardrails/guardrails.py` with a 2,000-character message cap and a deterministic check for common prompt-injection phrases.
- `POST /ask` answers `422` for either, before anything is stored or sent to the model.
- Documents the guardrails in the README.

## Notes
- `NewMessage` still caps the body at 4,000 characters; the guardrail is the effective limit on `/ask`.
- The phrase check is a case-insensitive substring match on a short list. `/documents` does not run it.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q` (214 passed)
